scope: Component-level audit through October 2, 2026. Prepared code and synthetic tests are not achieved competition scores. Candidate-ceiling gains are not ranking gains. Fitting qualification does not imply selection/evaluation or leaderboard transfer.

first_place.publication_policy: No upstream source code or weights vendored; independently implement mathematical mechanisms and attribute the source.

third_place.scope: README describes Theo's contribution, not all team members' code.

components.component: Baseline co-visitation, event statistics, task ranking
components.our_evidence: Established pipeline plus accepted objective router 0.57100 private. Not equivalent to the entire winning candidate stack.

components.component: Winner multiple co-visitation variants and multi-hop configurations
components.our_evidence: A bounded two-hop replacement improved coverage but regressed achieved recall; not the full winning multi-channel union.

components.component: Winner v42 task-conditioned sequence MLP and hard-negative contrastive objective
components.local_validation: Mathematical loss fixture, gradients, padding, objective conditioning, exact retrieval ties, native optimizer-state resume. Not upstream trained-weight parity.
components.our_evidence: The learned representation was retained after a first reranker rejection, converted into candidate-to-session similarity features, passed full reserved evaluation, and contributed to the 0.57586 / 0.57601 promoted submission.

components.component: Eight winning neural candidate models v15/v18/v21/v23/v27/v29/v31/v42
components.our_evidence: All eight named mechanism variants are now materially covered under independent bounded adaptations: v42 is promoted as similarity evidence; v31 candidate-union/dense variants are closed; v27/v29 direct retrieval added +0.005065 candidate ceiling but only +7 orders, and their stable-pool similarity stack added +4 orders; v21/v23 added +0.001580 ceiling with +52/+9/+5 click/cart/order targets; v15/v18 equal-budget insertion regressed. This does not claim checkpoint parity or reproduction of the complete winning ensemble.

components.component: Candidate-aware neural integration with established order ranking
components.status: Adapted and evaluated in multiple fixed studies
components.design: v42 similarity stack: established 400-candidate pool plus learned similarity/query features; v31 branch: preserve established candidates, union complementary neural candidates before training, and evaluate fixed arms under fit-only cross-validation.
components.our_evidence: v42 similarity integration passed selection and full reserved evaluation, then scored 0.57586 private / 0.57601 public. v31 union/dense studies did not qualify. Later v27/v29, v21/v23 and v15/v18 retrieval/integration studies established additional representation coverage but failed their frozen order-side promotion gates. Order-side heterogeneous source fusion and a QueryFormer-style field-sequence model were subsequently tested and closed under fitting-only gates.

components.status: Adapted and evaluated; retrieval branch closed
components.our_evidence: Earlier generic similarity features were weak. A later action-specific click/time, cart and order Word2Vec retrieval study recovered zero additional targets beyond the stronger MF+v42 pool even when the candidate budget expanded beyond 1,000. Do not rerun unchanged.

components.component: Theo matrix-factorization / sequence-to-sequence feature stack and full 744-feature XGBoost system
components.status: Substantially adapted and evaluated under bounded studies
components.our_evidence: Exact MF-general/MF-intent retrieval plus v42 raised 20k fitting candidate ceiling by +0.032215 and recovered +1446/+261/+69 click/cart/order targets versus base400. Action-specific Word2Vec added zero incremental targets. Lag-conditioned Seq2Seq added only +0.000819 ceiling and no orders. Broad 579-feature ranking gained +0.000813; a 785-feature feature-rank/popularity/XGBoost/blend recreation peaked at +0.003234 with +54/+3/+17 hits but missed its frozen +0.0035 fitting gate. No full upstream equivalence is claimed.

components.component: Multiple ranker configurations and complementary model ensemble
components.status: Evaluated; current CPU family closed under frozen gates
components.our_evidence: The transition/source zmean_all3 arm completed 432492-session reserved evaluation at +0.002665 weighted Recall@20 and +308 order hits but missed +0.003/+347 promotion gates. The 785-feature CPU frontier later peaked at +0.003234 fitting-only gain but missed +0.0035. A new objective-specific 589-feature click/cart source-aware ranker on the stable 400-candidate pool has now cleared its fitting gate at +0.003535 combined weighted contribution with +186 clicks, +53 carts and 5/5 positive folds; independent selection is pending.

components.status: Order recipe closed; click/cart fitting-only challenger qualified for selection
components.our_evidence: Flat order source fusion tied the 400-candidate baseline and lost 40 orders on the 1200 pool. Reusing the source representation objective-specifically for clicks/carts on the stable 400 pool produced +186 click hits and +53 cart hits, +0.003535 combined official-metric contribution and 5/5 positive fitting folds. Selection remains unopened.

components.status: Independently adapted and fitting-only evaluated; current order recipe closed
components.our_evidence: A nonlinear field control gained +8 order hits / +0.001399 on 400 candidates but missed stability/gain gates. The explicit cross-attention model lost 10 orders on 400 candidates and 44 on 1200. No selection or evaluation labels were opened.

next_backlog: Run the frozen click/cart challenger once on the independent 20000-session selection cohort against the actual incumbent click/cart policy; keep orders unchanged.
If selection passes, freeze a reserved-evaluation contract and evaluate all 432492 reserved temporal sessions before any competition inference.

If selection fails, close the exact 589-feature source400 recipe and move to a materially different contextual feature-transport / nonlinear click-cart architecture rather than another tree/source permutation.
Use leakage-safe heterogeneous OOF stacking only after multiple distinct model families qualify.
Establish a fresh chronological confirmation cohort before the strongest final promotion after adaptive research.
Produce a new competition submission only after fitting, selection and reserved/fresh confirmation evaluation clear their frozen gates.
